samples.title: 一间小办公室，一家新 AI 公司
samples.scene: A compact cutaway software office viewed from a fixed three quarter overhead angle. Four workstations sit on a square tile grid, with only two computers powered on. A black haired founder in a white shirt and blue trousers stands at the door, while a black hoodie engineer sits at a computer. A cardboard box, one tiny potted plant and one server tower make the room feel like a new company. Leave an empty workstation clearly visible as an invitation to hire. A small pale blue white dialogue window says NEW COMPANY. The top resource bar reads CASH 100K and GPU 2. The bottom command buttons read HIRE, TRAIN, RELEASE. Warm pale flooring, muted blue walls and a green development indicator. The office is the main object, surrounded by functional game interface, not a poster.

samples.title: 人才市场：能力很强，签字费更强
samples.scene: The same small fictional AI company office sits behind a large pale blue white recruitment window with a pale blue title strip with dark blue text reading HIRE TALENT. Three tiny full body candidate sprites are arranged in three rows beside simple skill bars. The highlighted candidate wears a black hoodie and glasses and holds a coffee cup. Its row reads RESEARCH 99, ENGINEERING 92, SALARY 80K. A rival manager at the side of the window offers a giant pixel money bag, while the founder in a white shirt stares at a flashing COST UP bubble. At the bottom the orange HIRE button is selected by a small white glove shaped pointer. The joke is competitive recruiting and a frightening salary, not a portrait of any real executive. Keep the office and all characters visibly drawn as a low resolution simulation game.

samples.title: 训练 99%，显卡正在排队
samples.scene: A busy overhead AI office with six tiny engineers typing at desktop computers, one character jumping in inspiration and one character sleeping beside an empty coffee cup. A central pale blue white model development panel reads TRAIN MODEL S1. Its green progress bar reads 99 percent, and small numeric stat bubbles rise above desks. On the right a little GPU server rack has three glowing cards and one conspicuously empty socket, with a red queue icon. A purple heat meter is almost full, and a yellow warning panel reads GPU SHORTAGE. One engineer holds a red bug icon. The founder in a white shirt looks between a diminishing cash meter and the stalled training bar. Emphasize clear strategy game mechanics, small funny working animations frozen at their most readable pose, not a realistic datacenter.

samples.title: 发布模型，却像开了一场演唱会
samples.scene: A miniature model launch party presented as an in game event screen. A tiny stage is built inside the expanded AI office, with a pixel microphone, two square speaker stacks and colored spotlights made of simple flat pixel shapes. The black hoodie engineer stands beside a terminal with a MODEL S1 RELEASED label, while a second tiny staff member holds the microphone. A crowd of small office workers wave green and blue glow sticks. A pale blue white event panel with a pale blue title strip with dark blue text says LAUNCH NIGHT. Three small stat rewards read HYPE UP, USERS UP and CASH DOWN. The scene should read as a cheerful absurd software company celebration with concert energy, not a recreation of a factual real world performance and not an anime concert illustration. Keep a visible office desk and development terminal to connect it to the business simulation.

samples.title: 模型发布，同行的理智条归零
samples.scene: A comic industry reaction event inside the same pixel business simulation. On the left a large monitor displays a new model benchmark chart and a harmless cartoon yellow mushroom shaped burst icon inside the monitor only. On the right three tiny fictional rival researchers react beside their office chairs, one drops a coffee cup, one sits slumped on the floor, and one has enormous simple white shocked eyes. White square shock lines surround them. A large pale blue white popup reads INDUSTRY SHOCK. Two small stat bubbles read RIVAL MORALE DOWN and HYPE UP. Show no real bomb, no real explosion footage, no destroyed city, no injury and no weapon diagram. The mushroom shaped burst is a symbolic videogame icon representing an unexpectedly strong model release. The humor is the contrast between huge news and tiny office workers.

samples.title: 一键开源，价格也开始自由落体
samples.scene: A strategy choice window in a pixel AI company management game overlays a lively overhead office. The large pale blue white panel has two square option cards. The left card shows an open padlock and a gift box and reads OPEN WEIGHTS. The right card shows a closed padlock and a small coin stack and reads API SERVICE. A tiny founder presses a green RELEASE button between them. Beside the window a big chunky pixel price tag falls from 10 to 1, and a rival shop counter has a flashing SALE sign. A smiling crowd arrives at the door while the cash meter wobbles. Add small reward and cost icons for community, revenue and compute load. Make the tradeoff legible as a game mechanic rather than an assertion that all open weights models are open source.

samples.title: 这次第一，下一秒也许就不是了
samples.scene: A large pale blue white ranking window with a dark pale blue title strip with dark blue text dominates an overhead AI office game screen. It reads MODEL RANKING. Five rows show deliberately fictional model names. STARDUST S1 is highlighted at rank 1 with a gold star, followed by ORBIT, SPARK, NOVA and ECHO. Use short colored stat bars instead of long text. A little yellow up arrow lifts the first row while a rival model sprite climbs a staircase at the edge. A small clock and NEXT RELEASE icon suggest that the lead is temporary. In the office behind the window, engineers celebrate with raised arms while one remains seated debugging. A secondary tiny warning badge reads EVAL NOT ALL. The mood is joyful but knowingly satirical about benchmark races.
